title: Common kingfisher call recorded in December 2015 at Anjarle, Ratnagiri
author: Sharadapte
changes: Common kingfisher (Alcedo atthis) giving its thin, high, whistled 'tseee' calls, recorded at Anjarle, Ratnagiri, India. Trimmed to 0.00–2.29 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
